storage: Keep at 0 to 4 degrees C and cook within 1 to 2 days of buying, or freeze in portions; thaw in the fridge, not on the counter.
looksLike: Pink-beige, soft, slightly irregular pieces of leg meat with the bone and skin removed; darker and juicier than breast. Packs hold 5 to 7 pieces per 450 g.
howToPick: Pink, moist, firm meat with no grey patches, no sour smell and no excess liquid in the pack. Check the date and cold-chain.
shelfLife: 1 to 2 days in the fridge; 6 to 9 months frozen (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 150 g per serving (boneless chicken, thigh or breast; about 2 thighs)
